text:
maya: Heads up — rolled `fast-path` streaming for eu canary ~10m ago and we're seeing reconnect spikes and duplicate billing for some tenants. Console alert ALRT-3267 popped. Anyone tracking? :grimacing:

oliver: saw it too, getting p95 reconnect alerts. link?

maya: ALRT-3267 -> https://console.redwood/api/alerts/ALRT-3267
logs snippet:
```
2026-03-23T10:21:05Z INFO route-swap previous=eu-west-2 next=eu-west-1 session=abc123
2026-03-23T10:21:06Z WARN resume-failed session=abc123 cause=kv-prefix-miss
2026-03-23T10:21:07Z INFO handled request session=abc123 billed_tokens=47
```
jess: pattern looks like resume id lost on route swap -> client does full regen against new shard -> billing records tokens twice. Console sampling for reconnects is 1% so the per-route jump was invisible.

ande: that sampling got us blind. propose temporary increase `reconnect.sample_frac=0.2` for eu-* for 20m and add a per-route duplicate billing tile to the rollout dashboard.

oliver: ok to bump sampling for diagnostics but we should gate it with a one-click flag on the deploy page to limit query cost.

maya: plan: 1) increase sampling to 0.2 for eu region for 20m 2) implement a soft sticky heuristic: prefer previous shard for 20s after a mode flip 3) add per-route duplicate_tokens chart to canary dashboard.

jess: sticky window avoids most double-regens; tradeoff: potential slight tail latency if old shard overloaded. acceptable during short diagnostic window.

oliver: also want a cheap dedupe guard in billing pipeline keyed by resume_id+client_hash to prevent double charge in quick double-resume cases. low-risk and reversible.

maya: agree. will schedule RFC for the billing guard. executing sampling bump + sticky soft-fallback now. tagging @andre to run queries and watch cost.

andre: running query, will post numbers in ~3m. :eyes:

sre-bot: [automated] Alert ALRT-3267 acknowledged by maya. Created PMT-7820.

jess: small console-UX ask: surface sampling controls on rollout page (or at least link to them) — currently too hidden under advanced. would have avoided the blindspot.

maya: will ping product-console. action items:
- maya: bump reconnect.sample_frac for eu -> 0.2 (20m)
- andre: add per-route duplicate_tokens tile + monitor query cost
- oliver: draft billing dedupe RFC
- jess: update rollout runbook with sticky-window note

andre: results: duplicate_tokens spike aligns with route-swap window; original shard CPU +12% at T+6m. dashboard pushed.

maya: sampling bump active. monitoring. :thumbsup:
